body:
Status update, still running, live run still healthy: it just improved on its own scan -- Strong Bull regime now showing 55.6% WR / 72.7% validation on its finest scan pass, better than the earlier wide/mid passes. Further along than the prior truncated attempt.

Finished everything I can build without real trade data: added fractional differentiation (the last item from your document's method list -- nothing from Part VIII.0 is left unbuilt), then wired the trial-count reader (real count from forge_ledger.json: 163 distinct warrants, not hand-supplied) and built the actual pipeline that produces CERBERUS_VERDICT.json -- the deliverable your document names. Ran it end-to-end: it self-tests both toolkits first, then produces a REAL finding, not just plumbing -- the current reducer stack (Kelly ceiling + drawdown fade + sentinel + correlation discount) can hit a worst-case product of exactly 0.0 simultaneously. Safe (undershoot only, matches everything already proven this session), but real, and now checkable with one command instead of a one-off calculation.

Wrote a single status file (SWORD_II_STATUS.md) that's the 30-second version of tonight -- what's running, what's built, what's genuinely blocked and why -- and pointed the "sword master tungsten" skill at it so any future session gets oriented fast.

Where this actually stands: I've built everything buildable ahead of real data. What's left needs either the live run to keep producing trades (still watching, will not touch the MQL4 source while it's active), or you, in the morning, deciding anything about scope. Sleep well -- there's a real live run going and a real, tested toolkit waiting for it, not a guess.
